source_caption_text:
Never forget Chief Keef’s brutal cough in “War” 😭

Chief Keef’s “War” is one of those songs where the cough is almost as memorable as the actual track. Keef is already going off when he suddenly breaks into an aggressive, brutal cough mid-song and just keeps it in like nothing happened.

That’s what makes the moment so funny. He could’ve easily recorded it again, but instead the cough became part of the song and fans immediately remembered it.

Years later, people still bring up that cough whenever “War” comes up. Chief Keef really left one of the most random and unforgettable moments in drill history on the final track 

#chiefkeef #funny #hiphop
